notes.title: Ver.1.1.4 Release Notes
notes.notes: Fixed:The game became unprogressable when Any Phantom, Fezaria, or Hitoyo took a full-area attack from the Demon Assassin.

notes.title: Ver.1.1.3 Release Notes
notes.notes:
Add "" to the Shooting text.
 Fixed : During hand selection effects, hand-switching cards to become inactive until a pouch card was moused over
 Fixed : Error in the damage prediction logic

notes.title: Ver.1.1.2 Release Notes
notes.notes:
Fixed a bug where Castle Tail + Fruit of the Elixir would incorrectly grant only 1 Shield instead of the intended 3 as described.
 Slightly improved the performance of the damage prediction display.

notes.title: Ver.1.1.1 Release Notes
notes.notes:
・Fixed a rare bug where repeatedly summoning high-tier Phantoms (about 4-5 times in succession) could cause them to disappear.
・Corrected the description text for Aftereffects.

notes.title: Ver.1.0.9 Balance Update
notes.notes:
Tale Cut:Generate 2 Tails→1 Draw,1 Discard,Generate 1 Tail.
 　Magic Reuse:Added Exhaust.
 　Bombardment:12→15Damage
 　Momentary Rest:Shield 5→Shield 6
 　Viora：Power4→3
 　Adjusted the contents of the Hand Deck.
 　Mana Limit:99→10

notes.title: Ver.1.0.8 Release Notes
notes.notes: Changed the flavor text of the card that appears at the end of the main stage.

notes.title: Ver.1.0.7 Release Notes
notes.notes: Guidance of Destiny：Fixed an issue where the tooltip for Fever was not displaying.

notes.title: Ver.1.0.6 Release Notes
notes.notes:
Fixed an issue where items would not be consumed when winning a battle by dealing damage with an item.
 Fruit of Focus：Spells→Spell

notes.title: Ver.1.0.5 Balance Update
notes.notes:
Guidance of Destiny: Now also generates 1 Overheat card.
 Stealth: Effect changed to "Gain 1 Mana. If there are no friendly Phantoms on the field, draw 1 card."
 Infection: Effect changed from "Remaining Life 4" to "Remaining Life 3."
 Adjusted the contents of the Gem Deck.
 Minor bug fixes.

notes.title: Ver.1.0.4 Release Notes
notes.notes:
Fixed an issue where Persistence could be used on the hero
 Reduced the background rotation speed during unlock animations on the result screen

notes.title: Ver.1.0.3 Release Notes
notes.notes:
Fixed an issue where the total number of discovered cards shown on the result screen would change incorrectly
 Updated the cards that appear during the prologue

notes.title: Ver.1.0.2 Release Notes
notes.notes: Fixed an issue where the top and bottom of the screen were cut off when using fullscreen mode on ultrawide displays.

notes.title: Phantomancer Release Date
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,
This is Cloudgear Games.

We’re excited to announce that Phantomancer will launch on Steam on April 11, 2025.
The game will be available at midnight JST (Japan Standard Time) on April 11.
That’s 8:00 AM PDT (Pacific Daylight Time) on April 10.

Please consider adding the game to your wishlist!

We’ve also created a public Discord server.
Feel free to use it for reporting bugs after the game’s release or to connect with other players:
